name: fable_cyber_shaders
description: Fixed-point cyberpunk software-shader faces: low-res 2D SDF fields with distance-baked glow, RGB565 palette LUTs, Bayer dithering, scanlines, chromatic offsets, smooth-min liquid blends, wireframes, orbs, optics, LED matrices, and glitch effects.
language: C11, integer/fixed-point only (no float anywhere, verified on Xtensa)

input.clock: uint32 sample counter at 16 kHz; sole time source for all idle motion

memory.stack: small fixed frames; largest transient is a 120-byte row-offset array

entry_points.render: cyber_face_render(ctx, profile, keyframe, sample_clock, rgb565, pixel_capacity)

integration.profile_mapping: CYBER_PROFILE_* values are FACE_RENDER_* minus FACE_RENDER_NEON_SDF_CYAN, in enum order
integration.shim: cast/memcpy face_keyframe_t to cyber_keyframe_t and forward face_render_frame calls; both structs are static-asserted to 12 bytes

architecture: Stage A evaluates SDF/glow fields at 80x60 (40x30 for hub75-neon) into a caller-owned byte plane; stage B upscales 2x (4x) to 160x120 applying palette LUTs, 8x8 Bayer index dithering, scanlines, chromatic RGB565 channel offsets, rolling bars, and per-row jitter. holo-wireframe instead stamps additive 5x5 glow kernels along segments into a full-resolution accumulation plane and colorizes 1:1.
idle_motion: Deterministic from the sample clock: jittered ~3.4 s blinks (fast close, hold, slower open, occasional double blink, pre-blink anticipation widen), ~1.4 s saccades with smoothstep transitions and micro-drift, ~4.2 s breathing bob modulating glow, speech squint, centred/quickened speaking gaze, expression-driven brows and mouth curve.

profiles.look: Filled rounded-box eyes, parabolic-bent capsule mouth, capsule brows; additive neon glow on black; cyan ramp
Lidded-disc eyes (lid plane sweeps the disc), same mouth/brow rig; magenta ramp with 1-cell chromatic fringe
Eye/mouth blobs plus a drifting droplet, all fused with the quadratic polynomial smooth minimum; wobble phases differ per blob; rim highlight on the zero contour; teal-to-white ramp
Neon face on a phosphor green-cyan ramp behind CRT artifacts: 75% scanlines, 1-cell chromatic offset, rolling brightness bar, periodic horizontal hum jitter, separable vignette
Octagonal head outline with bright vertex nodes, diamond eyes, trapezoid mouth with optional teeth ticks, brows; interlaced rows, drifting scan band, chromatic fringe, rare hologram flicker
Breathing ring orb with soft interior haze, two blinkable eye dots inside, three orbiting satellites; ring radius and satellite wobble follow speech; indigo-violet ramp

Single HAL-style lens: hot core dimmed by a lid shutter (blinks close the aperture), two iris rings, specular highlight tracking gaze, ambient chassis glow, vignette; red-amber ramp; core pulses with speech

40x30 LED matrix simulation: chunky SDF face quantized to 8 brightness levels with temporal 2x2 dithering, rendered as round LED dots with dim edges and dark grid gaps via pre-scaled palettes; hot-pink ramp
Siri-style screen-border glow sweeping through eight hue bands (band-packed palette: 8 hues x 32 levels), brightening with speech; minimal tinted-white eyes and mouth in the centre
Ice-white neon face corrupted on a deterministic schedule (~every 2.4 s, 160-380 ms, triangular envelope): per-band row tearing, chromatic split spikes, block dropouts, one-row white flash at peak

Classic four-term sine plasma cycling through a seamless indigo/magenta/cyan cosine-palette wheel (lower 128 entries); the face silhouette remaps into a bright ramp (upper 128) so eyes and mouth read as luminous cutouts

verification.tests: tests/test_cyber_face.c: metadata, argument validation, cross-context determinism, guard-band overflow checks, idle-motion/blink/speech visibility per profile, 400-case keyframe fuzz, 55 golden FNV-1a64 frame hashes
verification.wasm_byte_identity: make wasm-verify diffs the full golden hash table between the host build and the emscripten/node build (verified identical) and runs the entire suite under WASM
verification.xtensa: make xtensa-check cross-compiles with xtensa-esp32s3-elf-gcc -O2 -Werror and asserts no soft-float helper symbols; total .text about 13.9 KiB
verification.budget: worst profile 146.9 us/frame on host; with a pessimistic 100x host-to-S3 factor that is ~14.7 ms/frame against the 33.3 ms budget at 30 fps

files.src/cyber_internal.h: fixed-point toolkit, SDF primitives, motion state
files.src/cyber_profiles.c: the eleven field renderers and effect passes
files.Makefile: test / bench / preview / regen-golden / wasm-verify / xtensa-check
